entry.title: Ledger-Driven Ingestion: Honest Failure Classification for Long-Lived Corpora
entry.summary: We present a driver-based ingestion architecture in which the enrichment ledger is the work queue rather than a receipt log. We show that centralizing failure classification eliminates a class of silent mislabelings, and that retry-on-newer-engine semantics close the self-healing loop with zero redundant work.
